limits: No physical Android microphone, audible playback, OS screen-lock or on-device scrolling measurement.
Skin checks cover DOM ownership and lifecycle; they do not measure rendered CSS or phone frame times.
Browser compositor, native scroll inertia and physical microphone/speaker playback were not measured by the portable suite.
